thread:
jen: Heads-up — we're switching payroll vendors in early April (last PayRollCo run Apr 3, first Nimbus run Apr 10). Question: will 401(k) custody/admin fees or per-payroll deduction remittance be impacted mid-quarter? Worried about a remittance gap and whether we need an off-cycle. CC @alexa-payroll

sam_peopleops: Thanks Jen — we'll help coordinate. Which vendors exactly?

jen: Outgoing = PayRollCo, incoming = NimbusPay. US employees only. Two concerns: 1) employee deferrals getting held up 2) BrightFund admin/custody fees billed quarterly — who handles those during transition?

alexa-payroll: In practice we map deduction codes and send contribution files each payroll. Vendor billing for admin fees goes to Finance monthly/quarterly. If contributions are delayed, recordkeeper may consider them late deposits (ERISA risk). I'll ping benefits vendor for specifics. @ben-plan

ben-plan: BrightFund here — short answer: contributions are remitted per-employer bulk file; admin fees are billed on our side quarterly to your Finance contact. During a payroll vendor migration the safest pattern is to aggregate/pay contributions for the affected pay dates promptly. If you remit within ~7 business days we usually don't escalate.

jen: Good to know. Action items I'm seeing: 1) Payroll (PayRollCo) export final files through Apr 3 2) Nimbus to accept any retro adjustments and send consolidated remittance 3) Finance to cover BrightFund admin invoice if timing overlaps. @alexa-payroll @sam_peopleops

alexa-payroll: Agreed. Also need to ensure deduction codes are identical across vendors or mapped. For reference our codes are: ```CSV
code,description
401K_PRE,401(k) pretax
401K_ROTH,Roth 401(k)
```

sam_peopleops: I'll draft a vendor handoff email and loop Finance. Quick Q: if Nimbus can't retro-process, will employees see a missing deduction on Apr 10? If so we may need an off-cycle payroll or a manual adjustment entry.

jen: :thumbsup: Prefer to avoid off-cycle but ok if necessary. We should also prepare a brief comms note for managers so they can answer questions about paystub timing.

ben-plan: Confirming BrightFund can accept a bulk/adjustment remittance with field "EMP_ADJ" to denote original payroll date for compliance. We recommend labeling the file "vendor-transition-remit" and include employee SSNs + original pay date. If remitted within 7 business days we mark as timely in our records.

alexa-payroll: I'll set up a 30-min handoff call Thurs 2pm PT with PayRollCo, Nimbus, Finance, and Benefits Ops to confirm file formats and cutover runbook. Invite incoming.

jen: Thanks everyone — I'll hold off comms until after the call, but will flag hiring ops and managers about a possible statement timing blip. Closing thread once handoff is done.
